item.title: Oil prices rise amid reports Trump may strike Iran before midterms
item.description: Crude oil prices climbed again after The Atlantic reported Trump is weighing new attacks on Iran before the U.S. midterms, as fighting in Yemen continues.

item.title: Isaias becomes first hurricane of 2026 Atlantic season, targets Gulf Coast
item.description: Hurricane Isaias formed late Wednesday as the first Atlantic hurricane of 2026, threatening the Gulf Coast from Mississippi to the Florida Panhandle.

item.title: Russia's health watchdog denies second infection in suspected plague case
item.description: Russia's public health watchdog denied that a lab worker who died in Siberia transmitted the infection to another person, amid global concern over the case.
